text: {"status": "answered", "answer": "Under the Share Certificate Account Disclosure (version DEP-DSC-017), the early withdrawal penalty for Share Certificates with a term longer than 12 months is 180 days of dividends. The penalty is calculated on the amount withdrawn at the dividend rate in effect on the certificate, and it may reduce principal if dividends earned are less than the penalty.
